name: zh
description: /zh translates the last assistant reply (or the n-th back) into Simplified Chinese with Haiku or Sonnet and shows it in a pane, code, paths, commands and names kept exactly; prev, next and close buttons, the last three translations kept.

model.title: Translation model
model.description: haiku: fast and cheap (default); sonnet: slower, better with dense technical prose. Used by /zh and the pane's prev and next.
